elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "Garman further warrants that the services provided under this Agreement, including the Maintenance Services, shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner..."

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Retained Section 12: "Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects" — an express software-to-specification (documentation) warranty.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: "For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services" — at least twelve months.
Inserted services warranty runs "for a period of 30 days following their performance"; the preferred 90-day services period is not rendered.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "Garman shall repair or replace the non-conforming Software or services..."
"...or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services."

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the retained or inserted operative language; would require an express "Garman warrants that it will comply with all applicable laws" undertaking.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious-code/virus warranty in Section 12 as rendered; would require an express warranty that the Software and services contain no viruses, disabling code or other malicious code.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Retained: "For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date... Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects" — an express software-to-specification warranty well beyond 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Inserted: services "including the Maintenance Services, shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for a period of 30 days following their performance."

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "For breach of the warranties in this Section 12, Garman shall repair or replace the non-conforming Software or services..."
Inserted: "...or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services." Remedy is not stated to be at Vendor's sole option, so refund is genuinely available.

reasons: Fallback is complete: the retained Section 12 software-to-Specifications warranty runs for the acceptance period plus one year (far exceeding 90 days), and the single inserted sentence supplies the previously absent 30-day services warranty plus an express repair/replace-or-refund remedy covering both Software and services.

Preferred is not complete: the services warranty period is 30 days rather than 90 days, and there is no compliance-with-applicable-laws warranty and no no-malicious-code warranty in the rendered language.

Minimality holds: nothing is deleted, the favourable existing one-year software warranty and the Section 10(c) best-efforts repair obligation are untouched, and only two operative sentences are added. The 'professional and workmanlike' standard is the substantive content of the services warranty itself rather than a free-standing extra, and no survival tail, expense allocation, procedure or boilerplate was appended.

Intent preserved: the Section 8(b) acceptance-period refund, the Fee Schedule chargeable-repair carve-outs and the Maintenance Services mechanics all survive without contradiction; the remedy sentence is scoped to "the warranties in this Section 12" so it does not override the separate maintenance repair regime, and it leaves no undefined term or dangling cross-reference.

If the drafter wishes to reach the preferred level, the operative repairs are: change "30 days" to ninety (90) days in the services warranty, add an express warranty of compliance with applicable laws, and add an express warranty that the Software and services contain no viruses, disabling devices or other malicious code.
